cards.text: Meet Saul, a man who has been going from house to house, dragging off men and women and putting them in prison (Acts 8:3). Now he's still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord.
He goes to the high priest and asks for letters to the synagogues in Damascus. Friend, this man isn't just mad, he's got PAPERWORK.

cards.question: Saul's letters from the high priest are for the synagogues in Damascus. What does he plan to do with followers of the Way he finds there?

answers.text: Bring them to Jerusalem as prisoners
Drive them out of the city
Put them on trial in Damascus

cards.question: True or false: Saul's letters are for going after only the men who belong to the Way.

cards.text: So Saul hits the road with his letters. He's almost to Damascus when suddenly a light from heaven flashes around him.
Saul falls to the ground and hears a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?” Friend, all that PAPERWORK, and not one page covers THIS.

cards.question: On the ground, Saul asks the voice, “Who are You, Lord?” Who is speaking to Saul?

cards.text: “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied. Saul's been chasing down believers, and the whole time he's been chasing JESUS.

cards.question: Jesus tells Saul to get up and go into the city. What does Jesus say will happen to Saul there?

answers.text: He will be told what he must do
He will meet the high priest there
He will be put on trial there

cards.question: Saul isn't traveling alone. The men traveling with him stand there ___.

cards.text: The men hear the voice, but they don't see anyone. Then Saul gets up from the ground, and when he opens his eyes, he can't see a thing.

cards.question: Saul can't see a thing. How do the men traveling with him get him into Damascus?
True or false: In Damascus, Saul goes three days without eating or drinking anything.

cards.text: In Damascus there's a disciple named Ananias (not the Ananias of Acts 5:1), and the Lord speaks to him in a vision. The Lord tells him, “Get up!” and sends him to the house of Judas (not Judas Iscariot) on Straight Street.

cards.question: The Lord sends Ananias to the house of Judas on Straight Street. Who is he supposed to ask for there?

answers.text: A man from Tarsus named Saul
A man from Cyprus named Barnabas
A man from Cyrene named Simon

cards.question: The Lord tells Ananias that Saul is praying, and that Saul has seen a vision too. What does Saul see in it?

cards.text: Ananias pushes back. He tells the Lord many people have told him about this man and all the harm he has done to the Lord's saints in Jerusalem.

cards.question: True or false: Ananias also tells the Lord that Saul has come to Damascus with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on His name.

cards.text: “Go!” said the Lord. I bet Ananias's knees were knocking louder than his hand was about to knock on that door.

cards.question: The Lord calls Saul His chosen instrument to carry His name. Who will Saul carry it to?
True or false: The Lord says Saul's work for His name will come without any suffering.

cards.text: The Lord says, “I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.” So Ananias goes to the house and places his hands on Saul.

cards.question: Ananias places his hands on Saul and greets him as ___ Saul.

cards.text: He says the Lord Jesus, who appeared to Saul on the road, sent him so Saul may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit. The man Ananias had heard all those things about is now BROTHER Saul.

cards.question: True or false: After Ananias places his hands on Saul, Saul's sight comes back little by little over the next few days.

cards.text: At that instant, something like scales falls from Saul's eyes, and his sight is restored. Friend, after years in the back of a junk drawer, I know how good it feels when the light finally comes back.

cards.question: True or false: Once his sight is restored, Saul gets up and is baptized.

cards.text: Saul takes some food and gets his strength back, and after three days of nothing, I believe it. Friend, I get cranky if I skip ONE cookie.

cards.question: Saul's strength is back. He spends the next several days in Damascus with the ___.

cards.text: And trust me, friend, the oven's still on, because Saul's story is just getting started.
